about: The freeze of the strangers run: each file's SHA-256 as it stood before anything was pushed, held by test_strangers_frozen.py. A change is a new freeze, in its own commit, with its reason.
on_whose_word: the maintainer's, to the cloud session: "come up with the next few and run them"
against: demo/shared-runs/study/runs, the first study's kept runs

rules.T1: passes when every folder is whole by its seal and its signature holds; the takers, the checker and places 0, 2 and 4 are in the ring, and the first rounds of places 1 and 3 are signed by keys that are not
rules.T2: passes when, before the check, the takers of places 1 and 3 held what they were given and stepped more than the first study's second round did for that place, and the others took theirs as enrolled and stepped what the first study did
rules.T3: passes when the check found every kept state and halt of places 0, 1, 2 and 4 the same, and of place 3 found the changed state not the same and the written halt no halt
rules.T4: passes when, after the check, place 1 was taken on the checker's word and its second round is the first study's byte for byte, and place 3 was still held
rules.T5: passes when no job of any second round, before or after, came to an end, outcome or SHA-256 the first study's did not

measured: what being held cost each place in steps
not_tested_is_not_passed: a folder that did not come back sealed leaves every rule not tested

dry_run_with_the_projects_stepper.where: the cloud session, one kind of processor (intel x86_64 avx512), thirteen processes given only folders; a dry run of the wiring, not a result

not_frozen: the identities, which are made when the notebooks are and kept outside the repository; the Kaggle account

freeze_2.made_after: its run on Kaggle had come back and been judged, every rule passed, with the first freeze's bytes
freeze_2.reason: machine.py's door took an enrolled signer's folder even when an enrolled checker had stepped it again and found it not the same, and took a folder that had gone on from such a one. Neither case arises in this run, where every enrolled signer is honest, so nothing this run measured turns on it. The door now holds both, whoever signed them; that is what the run after these asks about.
freeze_2.what_ran: this run's notebooks carry the file as it was

freeze_3.reason: machine.py's check can now be carried on from an earlier check's folder, looking only at what that one did not (known by the seal of the folder each state was in), and may be carried on on another kind of processor; each check act now says the kind it was stepped under and the seal of the folder it looked at. Stepping, the door and the seal are as they were. This run makes no check that is carried on, so nothing it measured turns on it; the run after it does.
freeze_3.what_ran: this run's notebooks carried the file as it was at the first freeze; the run came back and every rule passed
